# star-chart rules

## Settings

- Stale cutoff (months without a push): 24
- Protect recent stars (days): 90
- Flag archived repos: yes
- Flag descriptions containing: deprecated, unmaintained

## Keep always

One pattern per line. This sentence is not a bullet, so it is ignored.

- `keepers/*`

## Categories to use

- Parsers
- CLI Tools
- AI Agents

## Categories to avoid

- Misc
